title: AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'query' in v3.0
body: I copied snippet from docs and called client.query('SELECT *'). It failed with AttributeError.
resolution: Client.query() was removed in v3.0.0. Replace with client.search(query=..., timeout=10.0).

title: TypeError: search() missing 1 required positional argument: 'timeout'
resolution: Timeout was made mandatory in v3.0. Pass timeout=10.0.

title: TypeError: send() got an unexpected keyword argument 'request_body'
body: client.send(request_body={...}) fails in production after upgrading to v3.
resolution: Parameter request_body was renamed to payload in v3.0.0.

title: AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'search' in v2.4
body: Docs bot gave me client.search(...) snippet but we are still on v2.4 and it fails.
resolution: v2.4 still uses client.query(...). Do not use v3 search methods on v2.4.

title: AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'paginate' in v2.4
body: Docs bot provided client.paginate() which does not exist in v2.4.
